result.one_liner: Monday.com is a work OS / project-management platform with a GraphQL API for boards, items, and workflows, accessible via personal API tokens or OAuth2 apps.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
If you don't have an app, follow these steps to create an app in the monday UI and locate your client_id and client_secret.
If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
The monday.com API is built with GraphQL, a flexible query language that allows you to return as much or as little data as you need.
Enable AI agents to work reliably - giving them secure access to structured data, tools to take action, and the context needed to make smart decisions.

result.notes: Personal API tokens are free/self-serve via a developer sandbox account; OAuth2 apps require registering an app in the Developer Center (also self-serve, no approval needed to obtain client_id/secret for testing). Some user roles (viewers, disabled/unconfirmed accounts, student accounts) cannot access the API. Official MCP servers exist for both the monday platform (boards/items) and monday apps (dev tooling).
